headline: In Two More Days, People Borrowing from Banks Less Than 400 Million Dong Will Receive Good News
summary: Circular 29/2026/TT-NHNN of the State Bank of Vietnam takes effect on 15 August 2026. The report says it affects people borrowing from banks in amounts below 400 million dong.
why: The State Bank of Vietnam is the central bank, and its circulars set banking rules that affect lending conditions and the profitability of listed Vietnamese banks.
